actions.name: Criminal actors use business email compromise (BEC) to steal shipments of food products and ingredients
actions.description: Criminal actors use business email compromise (BEC) to steal shipments of food products and ingredients valued at hundreds of thousands of dollars by spoofing emails and domains to impersonate employees of legitimate companies to order food products. The victim company fulfills the order and ships the goods, but the criminals do not pay for the products.
